title: NOAA Significant US Storms (1950-2025)
subtitle: 14,770 major tornadoes, hurricanes, and fatal weather events (1950-2025)
description: Curated subset of NOAA Storm Events database - 98.8% reduction from 1.23 million records to focus on significant events: F3/EF3+ tornadoes, Category 3+ hurricanes, fatal events, and storms with $1M+ damage.
